name: docker-mailserver
description: Production-ready fullstack but simple mail server (SMTP, IMAP, LDAP, Antispam, Antivirus, etc.) running inside a container.

latest_release.body:
## Useful Links 1. **Diff to last release**: https://github.com/docker-mailserver/docker-mailserver/compare/v16.0.1...v17.0.0 2. [**Our Changelog**](https://github.com/docker-mailserver/docker-mailserver/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md) ## What's Changed This update focuses on solving security-relevant issues for releases.

Merged Pull Requests
